item.title: RUMOR: Sony Scraps Olivia Wilde's SPIDER-WOMAN Movie; Now Open To Sharing More Characters With Marvel Studios
item.description: Sony Pictures has reportedly abandoned plans for the Olivia Wilde-helmed Spider-Woman movie, but is now said to be open to sharing more of its Spider-Man-adjacent characters with Marvel Studios.

item.title: WONDER MAN Promo Reveals First Look At Simon's Brother, Erik Williams (a.k.a. The Grim Reaper)
item.description: A new promo for Marvel Television's Wonder Man reveals our first look at Demetrius Grosse as Erik Williams, but he doesn't appear to have much in common with the comic book Grim Reaper.

item.title: Hugh Jackman Reveals Hilarious Reason Why He Wishes He'd Banned Wesley Snipes From DEADPOOL & WOLVERINE Set
item.description: Hugh Jackman has been playing Wolverine for over two decades, but Wesley Snipes beating him to a world record has the actor wishing he'd banned his Deadpool & Wolverine co-star from set.

item.title: RUMOR: Marvel Studios Eyeing STRANGER THINGS Star Joe Keery For An MCU Role
item.description: According to a new rumour, Marvel Studios has met with Stranger Things star Joe Keery to dicuss an MCU role, and fans are already throwing names like Cyclops and Harry Osborn around.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: Tessa Thompson Shares Interesting Response When Asked About Possible Valkyrie Return
item.description: Thor: Love and Thunder star has danced around a question about her possibly returning as Valkyrie in Avengers: Doomsday, and reveals whether she and Jon Bernthal discussed the MCU while making His & Hers.

item.title: The GODZILLA MINUS ONE Sequel Just Dated The King Of Monster's Next Rampage For Late-2026
item.description: Fans of Godzilla Minus One finally have a clear answer on when the highly anticipated sequel will roar into Japanese and North American theaters.

item.title: RUMOR: New Details On BLADE's Scrapped Supernatural Story And She-Hulk's AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Status - SPOILERS
item.description: Some interesting new MCU rumours have surfaced, this time revealing the latest of She-Hulk's Avengers: Doomsday status and plans for Blade to explore the origins of the Ebony Blade.

item.title: POWER RANGERS: Priyanka Chopra Might Set Out To Conquer Earth As The New Rita Repulsa
item.description: After Percy Jackson season 3 wraps, showrunners Jonathan E. Steinberg and Dan Shotz might be ready to “morph” their Disney+ Power Rangers reboot into action.

item.title: POWER RANGERS: Jonathan Entwistle's Plans For Netflix Series Involved The Multiverse And Beloved Fan-Favorite
item.description: New details have emerged about Jonathan Entwistle's scrapped Power Rangers reboot for Netflix, and for longtime fans of the series, it sounds like it would have been an epic nostalgia-fest.

item.title: CRIME 101: Watch Hemsworth Outrun Ruffalo In This Sleek Teaser Trailer
item.description: Amazon’s latest trailer for Crime 101 highlights an all-star ensemble, bringing together Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Halle Berry, and Barry Keoghan.
